How to play Glotan (She is DPS character):
2 path (As far as I know) to play it

1 with gateway posse (The one that search deck)
1 with her event siganture posse

It will be very2 long if I explain it here. I'll keep it short & experiemnting is your best teacher.

TLDR:
0. If you are not sure about rousing, always Rouse Glotan first, unless you have very good reason to rouse other character first. EXCEPTION: If you don't plan to use Glotan exalt (Such as in battle against multiple small mobs)
1. You want to keep her 4 cost card ready at hand (it has Retain).
2. Play around with her 2 cost card (you want to search or draw this card lots of the time).
3. When her 2 cost card is used a total of 3 time (State is saved between battles), the card will shine golden. In this case, MAKE SURE YOU CAN USE HER 4 COST CARD after casting this golden 2 cost card. -> This will enter her Exalt ready mode.

In Exalt Ready Mode:
1. Use Deadly duel, to fill her Alienus. At least once per turn,
2. Each turn she stays in this Exalt ready mode, the higher her exalt damage will be. Especially when enemy intent is attacking.
3. You want to use her Exalt, AFTER CHARGING FOR A FEW TURN. You can exalt early if you're sure the enemy will be dead.

=====================
If you play with her event signature posse,
You can spam her 4 cost card for Burst damage, useful for clearing mobs.
